title: Vibe Coding Can Get You Sued in 2026
description:
Comment "SECURITY" and I'll DM you the full 30-minute checklist.

Vibe coders are getting sued in 2026. Most haven't realized it yet.

The stuff that actually kills your app:
1. No Row Level Security. Anyone opens DevTools and reads your whole database.
2. API keys in the frontend. If it's in the browser, assume it's already taken.
3. No rate limits. One endpoint turned my $20 bill into $200 in a day.
4. Auth that only tested the happy path. Attackers probe the failure path first.

A 20-year dev shared the pre-launch checklist. I added what we run at the agency after 60+ builds.

Comment "SECURITY" and I'll DM you the full breakdown.

#vibecoding  #buildinpublic #aitools #saas #indiehackers
